name: android_upload_size_limit
description: Mid-complexity Android story with clear AC and measurable thresholds. The generator should produce happy-path, negative (oversized image), edge (boundary 5MB), and accessibility considerations.

ticket.summary: Upload profile picture validates file size
ticket.description: On the Profile Settings screen, when the user taps 'Change picture' and selects an image larger than 5 MB, the app must reject the upload, show a toast 'File too large, max 5 MB', and leave the existing avatar unchanged. Images at or below 5 MB upload normally and update the avatar within 3 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given user is on Profile Settings, when they pick a 10 MB image, then a toast 'File too large, max 5 MB' appears and the avatar is unchanged.
Given user is on Profile Settings, when they pick a 4 MB image, then the avatar updates to the new image within 3 seconds.
Given user is on Profile Settings, when they pick a corrupt image file, then a toast 'Invalid image' appears.
